# RelayAPI

## Endpoints

| Endpoint | Description | Behavior | Returns | Auth Roles |
| -------- | ----------- | -------- | ------- | ---------- |
| `PUT /relay/bundles/:grantId` | Upload an encrypted bundle for a pull grant; body is opaque ciphertext |  |  | owner |
| `GET /relay/bundles/:grantId` | Download an encrypted bundle; relay checks grant is active before serving |  |  | grantee |
| `DELETE /relay/bundles/:grantId` | Remove a bundle from the relay (called automatically on revoke) |  |  | owner |
